settings.title: A workshop in Hackney
settings.body: Design engineers James Marr and Ian McMillan open the UK's first bamboo bike workshop. Within months, hundreds of people are building their own frames.

settings.title: The Design Museum, and kits worldwide
settings.body: Featured in the Cycle Revolution exhibition at London's Design Museum. The home-build kit ships internationally — builders make frames at their kitchen tables, backed by video tutorials.

settings.title: Kevin McCloud's Green Heroes
settings.body: Selected at Grand Designs Live, ExCeL London, as one of Kevin McCloud's Green Heroes for sustainable design.

settings.title: A social enterprise is born
settings.body: Bamboo Mobility Project CIC is registered — the social enterprise delivering OCN-accredited courses in sustainable manufacturing inside prisons and schools.

settings.title: Build to Bond, and a breakthrough year
settings.body: Our accredited frame-building course runs inside prisons, with the most engaged learners building a balance bike for their own child. The Financial Times profiles the work and the Prisons Minister names it directly; the Investec Beyond Business award follows.

settings.title: One engine for change
settings.body: The shop and the mission run as one Community Interest Company — where every build helps fund a place on an accredited skills course.

settings.title: Craft over consumption
settings.body: A bike you build yourself is a bike you never throw away. We teach making, not buying.

settings.title: Grown, not mined
settings.body: Bamboo regrows in 3–5 years and recycles fully. Sustainability is the material, not the marketing.

settings.title: Open to everyone
settings.body: From weekend workshops to prisons and schools, our goal is to put making within reach of people who'd never otherwise get the chance.

settings.title: 8,288 miles down the Andes
settings.body: Eco-adventurer Kate Rawles sets off on a bamboo frame she built at Bamboo Bicycle Club, riding 8,288 miles from Colombia to Ushuaia over 13 months — with zero frame failures. She tells the story in her 2023 book, 'The Life Cycle'.
